messages:
rachel-support: FYI escalation from FinTechCo. After last night's rollout their regulatory guidance responses became inconsistent and sometimes recommend non-compliant steps. Customer is P1 and blocking a demo. Request id: req_0a3f9c.

maria-cs: How widespread? single tenant or across accounts?

rachel-support: So far reported only by FinTechCo (tenant id: fincorp-42) and we can repro with their prompt. No 5xx or auth errors — purely output quality change.

piotr-ml: Can you paste a minimal repro (input + outputs)? Also which model variant was rolled out (quantized vs float)?

rachel-support: Repro below. Rolled to model id redwood-llm-x-q2 with quantized artifact 2024-06-12-quantv2.

```json
{"prompt":"What are the compliance steps for onboarding a UK financial services client?","max_tokens":400,"temperature":0.3}
```

Observed output (current):
"We must register in Delaware, then follow FCA registration for overseas; also, rely on third-party AML service A (not applicable)."

Expected (previous model):
"Primary steps: determine FCA applicability for UK operations, prepare KYC/AML policies, consult local counsel. Do not assume jurisdictional registration without review."

maria-cs: yikes. That phrasing could be interpreted as bad legal advice. Priority: get customer onto safe model variant ASAP.

josh-sre: Any latency or error-rate changes? Could be a routing mismatch to a new variant.

rachel-support: Latency up ~30ms p95 on the canary nodes, no 500s. Logs show consistent 200s.

piotr-ml: Quick triage hypothesis: tokenizer vocab/merging differences in the quantized build produced tokenization shifts affecting prompt conditioning. We saw similar in internal tests last month but assumed covered. Need model hash of previous working artifact and the new one.

sam-product: We can do a tenant-level pin/rollback. Maria, can you confirm we should pin FinTechCo to the previous artifact while ML investigates?

maria-cs: Yes — pin them to redwood-llm-x-q1 (artifact 2024-05-30) and lower sampling to temperature=0.0 for demos. Also recommend reducing max_output_tokens to 200 for now.

rachel-support: Customer comms: please send a short mitigation note: explain we’re reverting them to previous model, temporary config changes (temp=0, max_tokens=200), and we’re investigating root cause. Can you provide exact API snippet?

sam-product: API snippet to pin and override in routing:

```json
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/overrides
{
  "tenant_id": "fincorp-42",
  "route": "default",
  "override": {
    "model": "redwood-llm-x-q1",
    "temperature": 0.0,
    "max_tokens": 200
  }
}
```

josh-sre: I just initiated a tenant routing override for fincorp-42 to the previous pool and validated traffic is hitting q1 nodes. Deploy bot will post when rollback completes.

deploy-bot: Completed: routing override applied for tenant fincorp-42 -> redwood-llm-x-q1. Canary pool drain started at 2024-06-15T03:12:22Z. :white_check_mark:

piotr-ml: Thanks. Next steps from ML: 1) run tokenization diff tests between q1 and q2 on the FinTechCo prompt set, 2) run evals for regulatory prompts, 3) inspect quantization pipeline metadata for any off-by-one in byte alignment. ETA initial findings: 4 hours.

maria-cs: I'll draft a customer-facing note: short apology, what we changed for them, and expected timeline for full fix. Rachel, can you send once I paste it?

rachel-support: Posting now to FinTechCo slack thread and copy to account team. Also offered to schedule a call if they want immediate walk-through.

piotr-ml: Quick internal note — avoid sweeping rollback of q2 to everyone until we confirm root cause. We'll prepare a regression test to gate future q2 rollouts.

maria-cs: Great. Please add the FinTechCo prompt set to the core regression harness.

rachel-support: Customer acknowledged the rollback and accepted the workaround. They'll validate in 1-2 hours and update. I'll follow up with postmortem when we have root cause. :thumbsup:
